name: Camping Hopfensee
beschreibung: Camping Hopfensee is located in Füssen and is listed in the campsite category. The site extends along a picturesque stretch of the natural bathing lake, providing direct access to the water. There are designated areas for seasonal and short-term campers as well as a dedicated meadow for tents. A central utility station provides dependable electricity and fresh drinking water hookups. The grounds feature a sanitary building and a kiosk. The surrounding Füssen region offers an extensive network of cycling and hiking trails.
